
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zhangyh-blog/p/19802042" title="发布于 2026-03-31 17:12">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">ultralytics yolo入门实践</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>一、配置本地Python环境</p>
<p>二、下载YOLO源码并解压</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/releases</span></pre>
</div>
<p>解压后的目录结构如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2385528/202603/2385528-20260331160334598-758663291.png" alt="image" width="252" height="361" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>三、安装YOLO</p>
<p>1. 可以直接使用pip安装，但是这样安装无法对源码进行修改</p>
<p>2. 源码安装，源码安装后，可以直接修改源代码。</p>
<p>源码安装方式，进入项目目录后，执行：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pip  install  -e  .</pre>
</div>
<p>四、体验一下使用已有的模型进行预测</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>1. 命令行执行预测</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>yolo task=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">detect</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> mode=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">predict</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> model=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">yolo26n.pt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> source=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bus.jpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>yolo predict model=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">yolov8n.pt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> source=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bus.jpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>参数说明：</p>
<p>model：指定用哪个模型进行预测（在执行时会自动下载这个模型，或者也可以提前下载好放在项目里）</p>
<p>source：指定想要预测的图片或视频</p>
<p>执行结果会保存在runs目录下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2385528/202603/2385528-20260331161230092-1727333685.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>2. 代码行执行预测</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ultralytics import YOLO

yolo </span>= YOLO(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">yolov8n.pt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, task=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">detect</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
result </span>= yolo(source=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bus.jpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, save=True)</pre>
</div>
<p>参数说明：</p>
<p>save：是否保存结果，存到run目录</p>
<p>conf:&nbsp; 表示置信度多少以下不显示</p>
<p>... ...</p>
<p>这些参数也可以直接在文件中指定：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2385528/202603/2385528-20260331162148571-1186133555.png" alt="image" width="978" height="486" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;五、训练自己的模型</p>
<p><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">上面用到的是YOLO已经训练好的模型进行预测的，我们要在它的模型基础上，用我们自己的数据集来训练自己的模型。</span></strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)">我在这里用的是电脑桌面截图，通过训练想让模型识别微信和飞书两个应用的图标。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)">第一步：准备数据集</span></strong></p>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)">我这里使用截图工具Pixpin截图，很好用。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2385528/202603/2385528-20260331163246770-2130718746.png" alt="image" width="592" height="330" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>第二步：数据集重命名</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>截图后，将所有图片按顺序命名如：1.png, 2.png, 3.png ...，（这里用到批量重命名工具https://rename.jgrass.xyz/）</p>
<p><strong>第三步：标注数据</strong></p>
<p>标注数据用到标注工具：labelimg</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2385528/202603/2385528-20260331163957363-1993019093.png" alt="image" width="419" height="251" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>第四步：整理数据的目录结构</strong></p>
<p>数据集目录结构如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2385528/202603/2385528-20260331164303652-407353835.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>其中：images和labels中的train和val需要分别一一对应，</p>
<p>labels中还有一个classes.txt，保存类别：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2385528/202603/2385528-20260331164738831-159158943.png" alt="image" width="476" height="243" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>第五步：将数据集放到项目中去</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2385528/202603/2385528-20260331164921253-1619518993.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;<strong>第六步：写yaml配置文件</strong></p>
<p>datasets目录下有很多模板，定义一个自己的即可：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">path: icons # dataset root dir
train: images</span>/train # train images (relative to <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">118287</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> images
val: images</span>/val # val images (relative to <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> images
test:    # </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20288</span> of <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">40670</span> images, submit to https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">competitions.codalab.org/competitions/20794</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
# Classes
names:
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: feishu
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>: wechat</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2385528/202603/2385528-20260331165127332-903912414.png" alt="image" width="1049" height="237" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>第七步：训练</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ultralytics import YOLO
# Load model
model </span>= YOLO(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">yolo11n.pt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
# Train model
model.train(data</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">icons.yaml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,workers=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, epochs=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">300</span>, batch=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">16</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2385528/202603/2385528-20260331165852698-1260422773.png" alt="image" width="829" height="287" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>最后一步：用训练出来的模型预测</strong></p>
<p>训练完成后，会在runs路径下生成train目录，找到最后一个train(我这里是train3)，train3/weights/best.pt就是训练出来的做好的模型：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2385528/202603/2385528-20260331170323951-1469608587.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">####&nbsp; 用 best.pt 模型进行预测看看效果：</span></strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ultralytics import YOLO

yolo </span>= YOLO(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">best.pt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, task=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">detect</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
result </span>= yolo(source=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, save=True)</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>效果如下（<span style="text-decoration: underline">效果可能不太好，重在学习过程</span>）：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2385528/202603/2385528-20260331170724797-553720303.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

</div>
